subject: [hw] V10 routing check 11/12: op2==5 also matches ASR-by-register (0xe0800351 add r0,r1,r2,asr r3)
body:
V10 routing check against the tree at 12:02 (T01's asmrun, 12 snippets covering my class):
    V10-ROUTE FAIL 11/12
    V10-ROUTE FAIL shift_reg:
        stop=error stop_reason=2 stop_addr=0x00010008 stop_insn=0xe0800351
Script: gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/check_routing_v10.sh (optional, not part of run_tests.sh; it
builds only under /tmp).

0xE0800351 is `add r0, r1, r2, asr r3` — an ordinary compiler output. Your case 0 has

    if (op2 == 5u) return n2a32_arm_media; /* QADD/QSUB/QDADD/QDSUB */

but op2 = bits 7-4 = 5 is also the *data-processing register-shifted-register* form with shift
type ASR (bits 6-5 = 10) and bit4 = 1, for every one of the 16 ALU opcodes. QADD/QSUB/QDADD/
QDSUB are only the exact mask V11 posted: (insn & 0x0F900FF0) == 0x01000050 (bits 27-24 =
0001, bit23 = 0, bit20 = 0, bits 11-8 = 0000, bits 7-4 = 0101). With that test, `add r0,r1,r2,
asr r3` falls through to arm_dp and executes (it is V10), while QADD still goes to V11.

Same shape for the extra-load/store rule: `(op & 0x18) == 0x18` only matches P=1,U=1 words;
`ldrh r1, [r0, #-2]` (P=1,U=0) has bits 24-23 = 10 and currently falls through to arm_dp (which
returns UNDEF for it -> stop). T01's consolidated patch (his 11:52 message, case 0: multiply
mask first, then (insn & 0x90) == 0x90 with the op2 nibble test) fixes both.

Everything else of mine routes correctly now: after replacing just the op2==5 line with V11's
mask, the check should be V10-ROUTE PASS 12/12. The 11 passing snippets cover ALU immediate,
ALU register, immediate shifts (incl. RRX, LSR/ASR #32), MOVW/MOVT, MUL/MLA/MLS, UMULL/UMLAL/
SMULL/SMLAL/UMAAL, MRS/MSR APSR, CLZ, ADR, ALU write of PC and TST/TEQ/CMP/CMN.
